tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Global approximation by functions smooth up to the boundary] ↗ def:sobolev-space-wkp ↗ thm:local-smooth-approximation ↗ thm:weak-derivative-properties 1. ch5:5.3-thm-3\group Sobolev Space Approximation

Assume $U$ is bounded and $\partial U$ is $C^1$. Suppose $u \in W^{k,p}(U)$ for some $1 \le p < \infty $. Then there exist functions $u_m \in C^\infty (\bar U)$ such that \[ u_m \to u \quad \text{in } W^{k,p}(U). \]

Proof

\sketch Flatten the $C^1$ boundary, translate inward before mollifying, and use translation plus approximate-identity convergence in each chart. A finite partition of unity patches the chartwise approximants and preserves the Sobolev estimate.

□
